retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated urban portrait featuring a high-contrast geometric monolinear title overlay against a textured concrete wall.
excludeWhen: nature or outdoor landscape settings are required
serif or handwritten typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A seated male subject in casual urban attire leaning against a light-colored concrete block wall, characterized by a warm, slightly desaturated palette and a prominent right-aligned geometric typographic block.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning diagonally against a horizontal grid of concrete blocks
Typography anchored to the right-side negative space of the wall
Warm skin tones contrasting with cool-toned shadows in the clothing
coreInvariants: Geometric monolinear letterforms with open counters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, seated and leaning back.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large geometric title on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's gaze on the left, following the diagonal of the body to the text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant of the concrete wall provides a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Beige and tan (concrete wall and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal and black (clothing and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm tint; high value range from deep shadows to bright highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Open or disconnected strokes in specific characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and N constructed with sharp, zigzagging diagonal lines
K with a floating diagonal arm
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized, custom geometric display face paired with a clean, widely-spaced secondary sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Horizontal grid lines from the concrete wall

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base square-geometric skeleton for the display text.
Appropriate for the clean, geometric subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with styled hair leaning against a light-colored concrete block wall. Use warm, desaturated lighting. Leave the right side of the frame relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned geometric monolinear text in the upper right quadrant. Use a custom vector style for the main title with sharp angles and open counters, and a clean sans-serif for the subtitle below it.

verificationChecks: Are the 'M' and 'N' characters sharp and geometric?
Is the color palette warm and desaturated?
Is the background a concrete block texture?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard fonts for the main title; it must look custom-drawn.
Do not use vibrant or saturated colors.

mustAchieve: Clean, architectural feel in the typography
Natural, soft lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the typography does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the concrete block lines are horizontal and straight.
Verify the monolinear weight of the display text is consistent.
Confirm the overall mood is urban and sophisticated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Concrete Texture + Right-Aligned Geometric Monolinear Typography
